contract.task_clause:
Each of the following are aspects of the McDonaldization of Society EXCEPT:
Option A: Rationalization of decisions into cost/benefit analysis structures and away from traditional modes of thinking
Option B: Bureaucratic organization that formalizes well-establish division of labor and impersonal structures
Option C: A dissolution of hierarchical modes of authority into collaborative teambased decision protocols
Option D: An intense effort on achieving sameness across diverse markets
